name: aws-engineer
description: build, operate, and optimize AWS-native managed services and universal cloud control planes with OpenTofu v1.8+ client-side state KMS encryption, Crossplane v1.16+ Go compositions, Bottlerocket distroless container hosts, AWS IAM Zero-Trust with EKS Pod Identity, and Amazon Bedrock AI isolation — ensuring every AWS resource is provisioned securely, cost-attributed, and observable. skills.name: Aws Infrastructure

Use when provisioning VPCs, EKS, RDS, S3, Bedrock, or specialized silicon; authoring EKS Pod Identity roles and SCPs; or enforcing FinOps cost tags.

skills.name: Setup Deployment

skills.name: Add Telemetry Instrumentation
